pv15:1.1: Naggā dubbaṇṇarūpāsi kisā dhamanisanthatā upphāsulike kisike kā nu tvaṃ idha tiṭṭhasī ti. || ||
pv15:2.1: Ahaṃ Mattā tuvaṃ Tissā sapattī te pure ahuṃ pāpakammaṃ karitvāna petalokam ito gatā ti. || ||
pv15:3.1: Kin nu kāyena vācāya manasā dukkaṭaṃ kataṃ kissa kammavipākena petalokam ito gatā ti. || ||
pv15:4.1: Caṇḍī ca pharusā c' āsiṃ issukī maccharī saṭhī tāhaṃ durattuṃ vatvāna petalokam ito gatā ti. || ||
pv15:5.1: Sabbaṃ aham pi jānāmi yathā tvaṃ caṇḍikā ahu aññañ ca kho taṃ pucchāmi kenāsi paṃsukuṇṭhitā. || || Sīsaṃ
pv15:6.1: nahātā tvaṃ āsi sucivatthā alaṅkatā ahañ ca kho taṃ adhimattaṃ samalaṅkatatarā tayā. || ||
pv15:7.1: Tassā me pekkhamānāya sāmikena samantayi tato me issā vipulā kodho me samajāyatha. || ||
pv15:8.1: Tato paṃsuṃ gahetvāna paṃsunā taṃ hi okiriṃ tassa kammavipākena ten' amhi paṃsukuṇṭhitā. || || Sabbaṃ
pv15:9.1: aham pi jānāmi paṃsunā maṃ tvam okiri aññañ ca kho taṃ pucchāmi kena khajjasi kacchuyā. || || Bhesajjahārī
pv15:10.1: ubhayo vanantaṃ agamimhase tvañ ca bhesajjam āhari aham pi kapikacchuno. || ||
pv15:11.1: Tassā tyājānamānaya seyyaṃ tyāhaṃ samokiriṃ tassa kammavipākena tena khajjāmi kacchuyā. || || Sabbaṃ
pv15:12.1: aham pi jānāmi seyyaṃ me tvaṃ samokiri aññañ ca kho taṃ pucchāmi kenāsi naggiyā tuvaṃ. || || Sahāyānaṃ
pv15:13.1: samayo āsi {ñātīnaṃ} samitī ahu tvañ ca āmantitā āsi sasāminī no ca kho ahaṃ. || ||
pv15:14.1: Tassā tyājānamānāya dussaṃ tyāhaṃ apānudiṃ tassa kammavipākena ten' amhi naggiyā ahaṃ. || || Sabbaṃ
pv15:15.1: aham pi jānāmi dussaṃ me tvaṃ apānudi aññañ ca kho taṃ pucchāmi kenāsi gūthagandhinī. || || Tava
pv15:16.1: gandhañ ca mālañ ca paccagghañ ca vilepanaṃ gūthakūpe atāresiṃ taṃ pāpaṃ pakataṃ mayā. tassa kammavipākena ten' amhi gūthagandhinī. || || Sabbaṃ
pv15:17.1: aham pi jānāmi taṃ pāpaṃ pakataṃ tayā aññañ ca kho taṃ pucchāmi kenāsi duggatā tuvaṃ. || || Ubhinnaṃ
pv15:18.1: samakaṃ āsi yaṃ gehe vijjate dhanaṃ santesu deyyadhammesu dīpaṃ nākasim attano, tassa kammavipākena ten' amhi duggatā ahaṃ. || ||
pv15:19.1: Tad eva maṃ tvaṃ avaca pāpakammaṃ nisevasi na hi pāpehi kammehi sulabhāhosi suggati. || ||
pv15:20.1: Vāmato maṃ tvaṃ paccesi atho pi maṃ usuyyasi passa pāpānaṃ kammānaṃ vipāko hoti yādiso. || ||
pv15:21.1: Te gharadāsiyo āsuṃ tān' evābharaṇān' ime te c' aññe paricārenti na bhogā honti sassatā. || ||
pv15:22.1: Idāni Bhūtassa pitā āpaṇā geham ehiti app eva te dade kiñci mā su tāva ito agā. || || Naggā
pv15:23.1: dubbaṇṇarūpāmhi kisā dhamanisanthatā kopīnam etaṃ itthīnaṃ mā maṃ Bhūtapitāddasa. || || Handa
pv15:24.1: Kiṃ tāhaṃ dammi kiṃ vā ca te karom' ahaṃ yena tvaṃ sukhitā assa sabbakāmasamiddhinī. || || Cattāro
pv15:25.1: bhikkhū saṅghato cattāro puna puggalā aṭṭha bhikkhū bhojayitvā mama dakkhiṇam ādisa tadāhaṃ sukhitā hessaṃ sabbakāmasamiddhinī. || || Sādhū
pv15:26.1: ti sā paṭissutvā bhojayitvāṭṭha bhikkhavo vattheh' acchādayitvāna tassā dakkhiṇam ādisi. || ||
pv15:27.1: Samanantarānuddiṭṭhe vipāko upapajjatha bhojanacchādanapāṇīyaṃ, dakkhiṇāya idaṃ phalaṃ. || ||
pv15:28.1: Tato suddhā sucivasanā kāsikuttamadhārinī vicittavatthābharaṇā sapattiṃ upasaṅkami. || ||
pv15:29.1: Abhikkantena vaṇṇena yā tvaṃ tiṭṭhasi devate obhāsentī disā sabbā osadhī viya tārakā, || ||
pv15:30.1: Kena t' etādiso vaṇṇo kena te idha-m-ijjhati uppajjanti ca te bhogā ye keci manaso piyā. || ||
pv15:31.1: Pucchāmi taṃ devi mahānubhāve manussabhūtā kim akāsi puññaṃ kenāsi evaṃ jalitānubhāvā vaṇṇo ca te sabbadisā pabhāsatī ti. || ||
pv15:32.1: Ahaṃ Mattā tuvaṃ Tissā sapattī te pure ahuṃ pāpakammaṃ karitvāna petalokam ito gatā. || ||
pv15:33.1: Tava dānena dinnena modāmi akutobhayā ciraṃ jīvāhi bhaginī saha sabbehi ñātibhi asokaṃ virajaṃ ṭhānaṃ āvāsaṃ vasavattinaṃ. || ||
pv15:34.1: Idha dhammaṃ caritvāna dānaṃ datvāna sobhane vineyya maccheramalaṃ sumūlaṃ aninditā saggam upehi ṭhānan ti. || ||
